summary: Today adds 65 detailed guides and 50 additional screened discoveries, including completion of 6 earlier screened entries. The expanded search covers 73 fields, 599 configured repository queries in recent-activity, newly-created and established lanes, and 18 model tasks, supplemented by primary-source web research across every field. Highlights span agent-directed editing, speech and captions, 3D/CAD, music and neural DSP, motion, physical interaction and unusual computational art. New to this library does not mean newly launched. Every included entry has a complete software-license review, a concrete creative AI use and a dated six-check assessment. No app was installed or run. Independent reliability, model terms and hardware gaps remain explicit; no new entry earns Recommended or Ready to try from popularity or documentation alone. The existing library already had current reviews for the week of October 26; today’s newly published records receive fresh source assessments. Search limits, failed requests and source access gaps remain visible below. Bounded collection and source-review coverage are not proof of exhaustive discovery or hands-on quality approval. Repository attempts: 520 successful, 24 partial and 55 failed; 98 queries were bounded or incomplete. All 18 model tasks were attempted without a recorded model-query failure. Codeberg and SourceHut remained access gaps. These limits were supplemented with live primary-source research, not silently counted as successful repository searches.
